headword: {郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}

definitions.explanation: A person who works at a post office, handling mail services, package delivery, and related financial services.

examples.japanese: {郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{預|あず}けた→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧。
examples.english: I handed the package to the postal clerk.

examples.japanese: {郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The post office worker helped me courteously at the counter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}{郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いていた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather worked as a post office worker when he was young.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧ (post office) and {員|いん} (member; employee). In Japan, post offices (⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧) are operated by Japan Post and provide not only mail and parcel services but also banking (⟦ゆうちょ{銀行|ぎんこう}→ゆうちょ銀行：27589_yuuchoginkou⟧) and insurance (かんぽ⟦{生命|せいめい}→生命：03296_seimei⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to ask a postal clerk
- {郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a postal worker
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{郵便局員|ゆうびんきょくいん}: the clerk at the counter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {郵便配達員|ゆうびんはいたついん}: mail carrier; postal delivery person — specifically the person who delivers mail to homes
- ⟦{局員|きょくいん}→局員：24361_kyokuin⟧: office worker; staff member — generic term for an employee at a bureau or office
- ⟦{配達員|はいたついん}→配達員：20275_haitatsuin⟧: delivery person — broader term covering any delivery service
